Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We’ve built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won’t come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Country Lead, Brazil
description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, and may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with applicable law. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Utilizar EPIs específicos: capote de chumbo, protetor de tireoide, óculos plumbífero, dosímetro, (sala de Hemodinâmica chumbada com aparelho de intensificador de Raio X). -Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.; Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade em sala, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu exame. Identificação do paciente no livro de sala com número de exame, médico que realizará o procedimento, horários de início e término. Cuidados de enfermagem: posicionamento do paciente na mesa de exame, monitorização (Sapo², F.C, F.R, PNI, PAM, Temperatura., Co²), punção venosa periférica, sondagem vesical, aspiração orotraqueal, oxigenioterapia, administração de medicamentos, assepsia e antissepsia.Cobrança de folha dos materiais utilizados em sala durante os exames. description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Com origem em um grupo empresarial atuante desde a década de 1990, a empresa surgiu da evolução do mercado de comunicação e da crescente demanda por soluções digitais capazes de gerar resultados reais para os negócios. Seu foco está em desenvolver estratégias de marketing digital que combinam tráfego pago, SEO, inbound marketing e gestão de campanhas, sempre alinhadas aos objetivos de crescimento de seus clientes. Com uma atuação consultiva e orientada por dados, a LinkMercado busca fortalecer a presença digital das empresas e impulsionar a geração de oportunidades de negócio. Em constante expansão, a empresa vive um momento de transformação e crescimento, impulsionado pela integração com um grupo português, ampliando suas oportunidades de inovação e desenvolvimento. O Salesjobs, em parceria com a LinkMercado, busca um(a) Gerente de Contas para atuar na gestão de uma carteira estratégica de clientes. Venha fazer parte deste momento de crescimento e transformação da LinkMercado! Reportando a(ao) Coordenadora de Relacionamento com Cliente , terá as seguintes responsabilidades principais: Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira estratégica de clientes; Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, acompanhamento e apresentação de resultados; Garantir a satisfação, retenção e fidelização dos clientes; Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas; Acompanhar indicadores de performance e propor melhorias estratégicas; Apoiar a gestão de campanhas digitais, especialmente em Google Ads; Identificar oportunidades de crescimento e expansão dentro da carteira. title: Brazil - Remote: AI Agent Architect - Industrial AI Systems
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Job Duties We are seeking a hands‑on and qualified AI Agent Architect to design and deploy advanced Agentic AI systems—comprising task‑specific autonomous tools governed by a master agent—to support complex technical decision‑making in industrial environments. This is a high‑impact individual contributor role for someone who can independently deliver full‑stack intelligent agents that interpret natural language queries and generate precise, context‑aware outputs by interacting with structured and unstructured data, APIs, and analytical engines. Key Responsibilities: Architect and develop a multi‑agent AI framework where autonomous agents coordinate to solve domain‑specific technical queries. Leverage LLMs, NLP, and tool‑based reasoning to automate data extraction, analysis, and insight generation. Build agents capable of integrating with engineering tools, simulators, databases, and knowledge sources. Collaborate with domain experts to align agent behavior with technical expectations and constraints. Implement safeguards to ensure accuracy, traceability, and reliability of AI‑generated outputs. Continuously optimize prompting, agent orchestration, and performance under real‑world conditions. Qualifications Certifications: Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer certification is a plus. AWS experience is nice to have, but not required. Industry Experience: Oil and gas domain experience is a strong advantage, especially familiarity with digital operations or engineering workflows. However, candidates with relevant AI system‑building experience in other complex industries are encouraged to apply. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Demonstrated expertise in building Agentic AI architectures, using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom stacks. Strong foundation in LLM‑based NLP, prompt engineering, and context‑aware reasoning. Advanced Python programming and experience deploying AI workflows in cloud or containerized environments. Ability to work with APIs, data models, and external toolchains across complex systems. Comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision in a cross‑functional environment. Nice to Have: Exposure to industrial domains such as energy, manufacturing, or heavy engineering. Understanding of vector databases, knowledge graphs, and retrieval‑augmented generation. Familiarity with Azure or AWS development environments. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation . description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo; Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia ou Auxiliar de Farmácia. Informações adicionais Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção. COMO É SER ESPECIALISTA EM GESTÃO DE PROJETOS EM MSF-BRASIL: Você irá definir e assegurar implementação de padrões para a gestão de projetos dentro do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, apoiando a tomada de decisão, garantindo uma execução eficiente de projetos, com qualidade e alinhada aos objetivos organizacionais. Irá facilitar a integração entre as diferentes áreas do Hub e demais departamentos, fomentando colaboração, aprendizado e excelência, elaborando e disseminando ferramentas, promovendo uma cultura ágil na organização, atuando na gestão de riscos e na maximização da contribuição de MSF-Brasil para sua missão social. 2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS? Garantir governança, previsibilidade e qualidade na entrega de um portfólio com demandas concorrentes, múltiplas partes interessadas e dependências entre áreas, equilibrando escopo, tempo, capacidade e impacto; Promover integração e alinhamento entre áreas e equipes de projetos, fortalecendo colaboração e cultura ágil (ritos, transparência e melhoria contínua), garantindo aprendizado e evolução de processos; Estruturar critérios claros de priorização e apoiar a tomada de decisão em contexto de recursos limitados e cenários dinâmicos; Identificar e mitigar barreiras organizacionais, operacionais ou de comunicação que possam limitar a participação equitativa das áreas e equipes nos projetos do portfólio. 3. COMO SERÁ O DIA A DIA? Gestão de portfólio, governança e planejamento Aconselhar a gestão do Hub na priorização de projetos com base em relevância, impacto, risco, dependências e alinhamento estratégico, garantindo transparência e visibilidade das prioridades para as equipes, apoiando a gestão de recursos e capacidades do Hub, alocação de pessoas para equipes de projetos e alertando sobre riscos e restrições; Coordenar todo o portfólio de projetos do Hub, garantindo clareza de papéis e responsabilidades, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados, visão consolidada e acompanhamento de status, dependências e marcos, reduzindo riscos de sobreposições e retrabalho; Apoiar a integração entre equipes de projetos, assegurando que objetivos, entregas e critérios de sucesso estejam conectados às estratégias e metas da organização, respeitando prazos e cronogramas pré-estabelecidos; Conduzir e supervisionar, em parceria com líderes de células e equipes de projetos, a realização de ritos ágeis e práticas acordadas, apoiando a integração, acompanhando a execução dos projetos e ferramentas necessárias, assegurando que objetivos, entregas e critérios de sucesso estejam conectados às estratégias e metas da organização, respeitando prazos e cronogramas pré-estabelecidos, incentivando práticas colaborativas, escuta ativa e participação efetiva dos diferentes atores envolvidos; Gerir diretamente alguns projetos estratégicos e/ou de grande porte, de acordo com critérios definidos (ex.: investimento, risco, transversalidade, criticidade para metas), assegurando governança, alinhamento e gestão de partes interessantes; Definir e garantir processos de transição de projetos para a rotina operacional, segundo critérios definidos, assegurando alinhamento entre partes envolvidas, continuidade das entregas, documentação de lições aprendidas e manutenção do histórico para aprendizado contínuo; Garantir que projetos tenham métricas claras, pertinentes, mensuráveis e alcançáveis, trabalhando em colaboração com a equipe de Inteligência de Dados, assegurando que relatórios integrados (status, riscos, marcos, capacidade e resultados) sejam disponibilizados às lideranças, monitoramento constante e tomada de decisão estratégica baseada em dados; Capacitação, gestão da mudança, melhoria contínua e cultura ágil Buscar continuamente formas de melhorar e otimizar processos de gestão de projetos, eliminando duplicações e retrabalho, definindo limites e acordos claros em todas as fases de execução; Apoiar a gestão da mudança associada a novos processos, ferramentas e iniciativas, promovendo adoção, alinhamento e engajamento das equipes envolvidas; Capacitar membros das equipes, incentivando o uso de metodologias ágeis, disseminando ferramentas, templates e boas práticas (planejamento, acompanhamento, comunicação e encerramento), em colaboração com o time de Projetos, Processos e Compliance (PPC) incentivando ambientes colaborativos, inclusivos e orientados à melhoria contínua; Promover transparência, ciclos curtos de entrega, melhoria contínua e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Facilitar integração entre as lideranças do Hub, por meio de alinhamentos recorrentes, escalando impasses conforme a governança do Hub, além de garantir comunicação clara com partes interessadas, promovendo alinhamento de expectativas e suporte à implementação das entregas, identificando possíveis barreiras de comunicação, alinhamento ou participação e propondo soluções para sua mitigação; Garantir documentação, registro de lições aprendidas e gestão do conhecimento do portfólio continuamente; Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração; Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais; Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos; Contribuir ativamente para a implementação dos objetivos definidos no Plano Anual e Resultados Esperados, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho, participando de monitoramentos periódicos e ajustando prioridades; Impulsionar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão em todas as ações e projetos das áreas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Requisitos Graduação completa em Gestão de Projetos, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas Experiência e conhecimentos de gestão de projetos e/ou portfólio com múltiplos stakeholders e dependências Experiência em projetos de marketing, publicidade e/ou comunicação Vivência e conhecimentos de metodologias ágeis e práticas de trabalho em squads (ex.: Scrum, Kanban), incluindo facilitação de ritos e gestão de backlog Experiência em facilitação, coordenação transversal e gestão de mudanças/processos Conhecimentos de Pacote Office e domínio de ferramentas colaborativas para organização, acompanhamento e comunicação Capacidade de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos 5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES: Certificação PMO Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas Conhecimentos ou proficiência em inglês 6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS? Você precisará demonstrar iniciativa e inovação para antecipar oportunidades, transformar desafios em melhorias concretas e estimular uma atuação mais proativa e criativa no dia a dia da área, além de planejamento e organização para estruturar ações com clareza, alinhar prioridades, otimizar recursos e garantir a execução eficiente das atividades em conjunto com as equipes de projetos. Além disso, espera-se flexibilidade comportamental para apoiar e facilitar processos de mudança, contribuindo para a adaptação do time a diferentes contextos e necessidades, e pensamento analítico para interpretar informações de diferentes fontes, estabelecer prioridades e embasar decisões de forma estruturada, contribuindo para soluções consistentes e eficazes. MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstram alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, consideraremos apenas a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como pessoas pretas ou pardas. description: The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Delivery Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Quality Lead. Ensure that HSE contractual requirements and the implementation/compliance to HSE documentation are duly applied by CTR and Sub-CTRs, through the day‑to‑day supervision and by making Company REP presence visible on site. Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary. Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool‑box talks are conducted efficiently. Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and "Code of Conduct" policy and promote the re‑enforcement of the Anti‑Corruption Program. WORK TASKS The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub‑CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations. The activities contemplated will depend on the nature of the work to be controlled, but will include document/certificates review, NDE and NDT tasks (and DT, in case of investigation) of various techniques, dimensional control, cleanliness control, and all tests conducted in general. Duties will include but not be limited to: Ensure that timely notification has been issued, 3rd party and/or COMPANY personnel and/or COMPANY other contractors are mobilized (if there is such a requirement). Ensure that the personnel in charge of performing the task is certified and has been trained adequately. Ensure that the equipment to be controlled is at an adequate state of completion (in line with ITP) to start the task. Ensure that corresponding procedures have been approved, available on the control area, read and fully understood by the person(s) in charge to conduct the control operation. Ensure that all equipment/tools to be used during the control program are in good working order and certified (for those where such requirement exists). Ensure that all consumables to be used during the control program are adequate, quality and quantity wise. Ensure that all necessary JRA and TBT have been conducted before commencing the work. Ensure that the work area is controlled (barriers in place for pressure testing or lifting equipment for instance) and that personnel working in adjacent areas is fully aware of the nature of the task to be performed and its associated risks. Witness and ensure that control program steps are strictly followed and recorded (pictures, paper charts, electronic files …). Sign off the control document during execution of the program, as and where required. Report and log any non‑conformity. Stop the work in case of non‑conformity and re‑assess the situation before resuming. Discuss with contractor/sub‑contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalise the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract. Ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule). Ensure that, following completion of the control program, the equipment is back to a state of readiness for starting the next step of the ITP. Participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues. Work closely with all involved parties to ensure correct information is transmitted and fully aligned. Issue weekly report to CPY stating status, look ahead, HSE and quality issues. The Service holder shall ensure the prompt issue of the dispatch dossier including all necessary certifications as well as the finalisation on time of the manufacturing record book associated with deliverables. The Service Provider will additionally assess and monitor the Welding and Welding Qualification Programs; assess and monitor the Testing Program ensuring equipment and tooling are fit for the intended purpose and conditions, with the technical assistance of the SPS discipline leaders; and monitor the impact of the qualification and testing program on the SPS schedule. Requirements Previous experience with WAG Manifolds and Subsea Structures. In-depth knowledge and experience of Testing regime across all phases (factory acceptance, integration, Stack‑Up and/or site receival). Knowledge/Experience of manufacturing sequences and relevant Quality regime. Degree and/or Master in Engineering and/or equivalent relevant professional experience. QC qualifications/certifications are a plus. Languages: Fluent in English (Spanish / French is a plus). Professional Experience: 20 years minimum. Experience within project/s: 15 years minimum. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions. Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off. Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes. Inbound Logistics & Storage Management Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility. Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations. Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required. Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items. Documentation & Compliance Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork. Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing. Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals. Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes). Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions. Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers. On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team. Organize and supervise unpacking activities. Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards. Professional Experience 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects. Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes. Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred). Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations. Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination. Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus). Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously. Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance. Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable. Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards. Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows. Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints. Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures. Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports). Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs). Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience. Note: Please submit your CV in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII) , há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em psiquiatria e obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Cumprir a legislação vigente relativa ao armazenamento, conservação, controle de estoque de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde, saneantes, insumos e matérias-primas, bem como as normas relacionadas com a distribuição e utilização dos mesmos. Estabelecer um sistema eficiente, eficaz e seguro de transporte e dispensação, com rastreabilidade, para pacientes em atendimento pré-hospitalar, ambulatorial ou hospitalar, podendo implementar ações de atenção farmacêutica. Participar das decisões relativas à terapia medicamentosa, tais como protocolos clínicos, protocolos de utilização de medicamentos e prescrições; supervisionar o fracionamento de medicamentos. Desenvolver e participar de ações assistenciais multidisciplinares, dentro da visão da integralidade do cuidado, interagindo com as equipes de forma interdisciplinar. Realizar ações de farmacovigilância, tecnovigilância e hemovigilância no hospital e em outros serviços de saúde, notificando as suspeitas de reações adversas e queixas técnicas, às autoridades sanitárias competentes. Promover ações de educação para o uso racional de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde e saneantes, aos demais membros da equipe de saúde. Exercer atividades de ensino, por meio de programas educacionais e de formação (treinamento e educação permanente) e programas de pós-graduação (Residência em Farmácia Hospitalar), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de recursos humanos. Desenvolver ações de gerenciamento de riscos hospitalares, como detecção de reações adversas a medicamentos, queixas técnicas, problemas com produtos para a saúde, saneantes, kits diagnósticos e equipamentos. Prevenir e/ou detectar erros no processo de utilização de medicamentos. Zelar pelo adequado gerenciamento dos resíduos resultantes das atividades técnicas desenvolvidas nos serviços de atendimento pré-hospitalar, na farmácia hospitalar e em outros serviços de saúde, atendendo às normas sanitárias e de saúde ocupacional. Realizar e manter registros das ações farmacêuticas, observando a legislação vigente. Orientar e acompanhar, diretamente, auxiliares e técnicos de farmácia na realização de atividades nos serviços de farmácia hospitalar, treinando-os e capacitando-os para tal; a supervisão e/ou competência dessas atividades são de responsabilidade exclusiva do farmacêutico. Realizar outras atividades segundo a especificidade e a complexidade do hospital e os outros serviços de saúde. Requisitos e Qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia. Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde. Benefícios Alimentação no Local. Vale Alimentação. Assistência Médica (adesão facultativa). Assistência Odontológica (adesão facultativa). Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias. Auxílio Creche. We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. Proficient in lower‑level engineering (garbage collection, context switching, threading). Experience with DevOps culture – agility, leanness, automation, CI/CD. Good understanding of application security. Passionate about technology and the Internet. Have worked in a successful agile development team. Have run engineering teams before with five or more direct reports. Able to operate autonomously: make decisions, set KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership. Practice data‑driven decision making. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. title: Jr Project Manager
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail‑oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your Future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well‑rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non‑technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical And Professional Experience SCRUM or Project Management skills Organization and planning skills Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration MBA or postgraduate degree in project management Availability for travel Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced English MS Project or other Project Management software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Customer Service , Delivery Station Customer Support
description: This is a full-time, permanent, non-remote position based in São José - SC and does not offer relocation benefits. Job applicants must be located and legally authorized to work in Brazil in order to be eligible for consideration. This is an on‑site position with a 5x2 schedule, including weekends and holidays. Responsibilities Communicating with customers via phone and email. Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs. Upholding company values and treating every customer with respect. Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers. Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to customer concerns. Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer inquiries. Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the best customer outcome. Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse staff, associates, delivery partners, and customers when they need guidance, helping resolve issues to ensure that the customer receives their package or a solution to their problem. Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart, connecting with our customers each day using your in‑depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses. Basic Qualifications High school or equivalent. Speak, write, and read fluently in English. Experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Outlook. Experience in Customer Service. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience. Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mobile Staff Software Engineer
description: About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences. Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Why Join Us Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions. Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on. Innovation-Driven Culture: Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. Career Growth: Develop as a strategic engineering, working on complex technical and organizational challenges. description: About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. Get to Know our Team Our Backend Engineering team builds the scalable, fault‑tolerant systems and APIs that power our global travel platform across pricing, inventory, customer data, bookings, payments, and more. We operate high‑scale, mission‑critical services with frequent releases, using modern engineering practices in CI/CD, automated testing, resilience, and observability. Our engineers work on complex distributed systems using technologies such as Scala, Go, Kafka, and Aerospike – while also exploring how Generative AI can accelerate engineering productivity, improve developer workflows, and unlock new product innovation. This is an exciting opportunity to join a team solving large‑scale engineering challenges while helping shape how AI is applied to the future of travel technology. The Opportunity The Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class development managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams. In this Role, you’ll get to: Drive the end‑to‑end execution of AI‑focused product and platform initiatives, fostering engineering scalability, organizational alignment, and high‑impact delivery. Be hands‑on – it’s one of the job’s fundamental tasks, and most of our development managers are writing and reviewing code, giving expert level coaching and guidance to their engineers. Be passionate about engineering and building things elegantly and at scale, stay abreast of industry trends, and have strong opinions about system architecture, engineering, and maintenance. Do full‑stack engineering: solid experience in all parts of the technology stack – infrastructure, client side, back end, performance, data, and others. Develop people – be able to inspire and help them achieve their potential; bring top performers in and integrate them into the business. What you’ll Need to Succeed Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, C#) Strong experience in systems architecture – especially for complex, scalable, fault‑tolerant distributed systems Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility Proficient in lower‑level engineering: garbage collection, context switching, threading DevOps culture – agility, leanness, automation, CI/CD Good understanding of application security Passionate about technology and the Internet Successfully worked in an agile development team Run engineering teams before with 5+ direct reports Operate autonomously: making decisions, setting KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership Practice data‑driven decision making It’s Great If You Have Proficiency in more than one programming language Equal Opportunity Employer At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.
